children: Saini takes on the expanded mandate after serving as Lead – Partner Management, Digital Lending, having been associated with the bank since 2015
IDFC First Bank has elevated Tushar Singh Saini to Head – Platform & Digital Capabilities, Savings (Retail Liabilities). Saini confirmed the development through a LinkedIn update.

He previously served as Lead – Partner Management, Digital Lending at the bank. Saini joined the organisation in 2015 as Territory Manager – Loan Against Property and has since taken on multiple responsibilities across the business.
His latest elevation marks a shift from his previous mandate in digital lending to a leadership role focused on platform and digital capabilities within the bank's savings business.
The appointment comes amid the banking sector's growing focus on strengthening digital platforms, improving customer journeys and expanding technology-led capabilities across retail banking.
